description: Create a new owner-scoped Brand kit defining typography, color palette, handle, and optional logo asset. Call before creating slideshow runs to establish consistent visual identity. Do NOT use to edit an existing brand; use update_brand instead. Requires workspace owner authorization. Persists initial brand record with revision 1. Returns created Brand entity with brandId and initial revision.

colors.description: Color palette tokens (primary, secondary, accent, surface, text).

logoAssetId.description: Optional image asset ID for brand logo.

title: Create brand
